messages:
maria_sales: starting an exec escalation for CascadeAI POC — CISO pushed back on SSO + SOC2 evidence, CTO asked for a throughput SLA and committed pricing. urgent ask: answers by EOD tomorrow.

derek_eng: can you confirm their peak qps and avg sequence? customer told us 50 qps peak, ~1k tokens/session. if true i’d propose 2 dedicated A100-40g nodes with autoscale 1->4.

sam_platform: noted. provisioning timeline for dedicated nodes is ~48h once billing/commit signed. we can enable burst capacity in the first week if they need headroom.

anika_sec: SOC2 — we have org-level report ready. customer asked for control mappings + evidence for data residency and KMS BYO. they specifically want KMS with key rotation audit.

elaine_salesops: pricing ask: CascadeAI wants a 6-month commit with discounted rate. sales is proposing list_price * 0.8 as a counter. need finance ok on >$60k ARR equivalent commit.

jeff_exec: i’ll join the exec call tomorrow 10am PT. can we get a 1-page exec summary + short tech slide deck by EOD? include SLA proposal and pricing banding.

maria_sales: @derek_eng @anika_sec assign owners: derek for throughput/capacity calc, anika for SOC2/KMS answers, elaine for pricing terms. jeff will lead call.

ops-bot: created ticket INC-4592 for CascadeAI SSO/KMS onboarding, assignee: @anika_sec, priority: high.

derek_eng: quick config draft for the recommended Dedicated profile:

```yaml
dedicated:
  nodes: 2
  gpu: a100-40g
  autoscale:
    min: 1
    max: 4
  kms: customer-managed
  sla: p99 < 120ms for generation (avg seq 1k tokens)
```

sam_platform: that SLA looks achievable in hosted eu-west with cache warming. we should add prefix caching and kv-cache prefill for the demo to hit p99.

anika_sec: for SSO they require SAML + SCIM user provisioning. request: test IdP metadata and a SCIM test account. i'll draft the control mapping doc and share link.

elaine_salesops: pricing bands — propose: 6mo commit => 20% discount; 12mo commit => 30% discount + 1 CSM onboarding credit. want legal to sign off on the amendment template.

maria_sales: linking the internal tracker: https://rwinf.co/poc-cascadeai (contains deck, pricing worksheet, SOC2 pdf). pls update sections you own.

jeff_exec: on the call i'll push for a short pilot acceptance criteria: p99 SLA + SOC2 evidence + SSO test. if they sign, we go to committed pricing.

derek_eng: i'll run a quick perf sim today against similar load and post results in this thread by 4pm PT.

anika_sec: uploading initial control mapping doc in 15m. will also include steps for BYO KMS key import and rotation logs.

elaine_salesops: @finance-team please review proposed discount bands. need final numbers by EOD tomorrow so we can present on the exec call.

ops-bot: reminder: onboarding runbook updated — /runbooks/poc-onboarding. added SSO checklist.

maria_sales: next steps summary: derek -> perf sim results (by 4pm PT), anika -> SOC2/KMS control doc + SCIM checklist (by EOD), elaine -> final pricing bands & legal template (by EOD tomorrow), jeff -> join call 10am PT. thanks everyone :rocket:
